tracks.title: Hollow Muster
tracks.intent: A stiff D-minor funeral march: low brass calls, clipped snare and squared bass. A four-bar answer opens the second half.

tracks.title: Last Light
tracks.intent: Sparse E-Phrygian bell waltz over slowly bowed fifths; long decays and open beats mirror the lantern sweep and rest.

tracks.title: Undelivered
tracks.intent: Hurried A-minor ostinato, pizzicato running eighths and syncopated rim taps. A rising counterline answers the descending delivery motif.

tracks.title: Crooked Procession
tracks.intent: A lopsided 2+2+3 G-Phrygian reed dance, plucked bass and dry wood taps. The asymmetric phrase keeps the packs restless without high-frequency chatter.

tracks.title: Final Entry
tracks.intent: A C-minor prepared-key ledger in 3+2, with a low stamping pulse and restrained rising harmonies. Three clipped answers leave a two-beat gap.

tracks.title: Copper Debt
tracks.intent: D-minor counting ostinato on low prepared keys, a falling bronze-bell answer and a single offbeat wheel tap. Wide rests separate each return.

tracks.title: Iron Jurisdiction
tracks.intent: B-flat Phrygian low-brass decree in six, two weighty three-beat chain phrases, bowed fifths and deep alternating toms. No relentless high percussion.

tracks.title: Third Latch
tracks.intent: A restrained E-minor funeral waltz. A sustained reed line passes between three low key chords; the third latch falls silent before the next phrase.

tracks.title: Last Carriage
tracks.intent: F-sharp minor carriage gallop in two groups of three eighths, muted strings, a distant single roof bell and a held driver phrase after each rush.

tracks.title: Cradle Ledger
tracks.intent: A spare F-minor cradle song, two low music-box notes answered by a single high bell. Bowed open fifths leave room around the nest tell.

tracks.title: Glasshouse Rot
tracks.intent: An uneven G-sharp Phrygian glass-key pattern in 2+3, dry droplets and an off-center plucked answer; short notes keep the ground warnings clear.

tracks.title: The Late Warning
tracks.intent: Four distant D-minor towers answer across a wide stereo field. Long low bell decays and a moving upper answer mark the deliberate rotating gap.

tracks.title: Needle Debt
tracks.intent: A tightening E-Phrygian reed stitch in 3+2+2. Paired short notes stretch into a held rescue phrase every fourth bar.

tracks.title: Aperture
tracks.intent: B-flat glass harmonics form three sides of a five-beat phrase; the fourth answer is an intentional rest, echoing the missing polygon edge.

tracks.title: Oven at Dawn
tracks.intent: Low C-minor oven brass moves in slow blocks while two light plucked crumbs answer each heavy note. Warm, dry percussion replaces a constant hiss.

tracks.title: Watermark
tracks.intent: A rocking G-minor current in two groups of three, alternating low/high plucks and slow bowed tides. The held middle register marks dry ground.

tracks.title: Last Departure
tracks.intent: F-sharp minor railway keys alternate left/right signal answers over a restrained four-beat rail pulse. A held departure tone follows every third stop.

tracks.title: Unlit Wick
tracks.intent: Three isolated A-minor lights, each answered in a different register. Quiet middle bars and barely struck toms let sanctuary warnings breathe.

tracks.title: Lecture in Bone
tracks.intent: Two opposed C-sharp prepared-key voices open then snap together, with one long space before the final beat. Dry wood taps suggest a lecture pointer.

tracks.title: Green Afterlife
tracks.intent: A rising F-minor reed vine in six, answered by clipped pruning plucks. Its final phrase opens into a plain held fifth rather than adding decoration.

tracks.title: Three Names
tracks.intent: Three synthesized E-flat minor organ voices enter in offset turns, then resolve together. Each voice has its own register and stereo place, with no external vocal samples.

tracks.title: Scarlet Vespers
tracks.intent: A slow C-minor organ prayer in five, two sanctuary voices answering a descending outside-in judgment line. Deep restrained bells arrive only at phrase boundaries.

tracks.title: The Open Half
tracks.intent: A B-Phrygian split-gavel call alternates low left and high right brass phrases. A conspicuous recovery rest separates each verdict from its answer.
